settings.title: Our story
settings.lede: Patented Performance Skins for barre, Pilates, reformer, Megaformer, and studio fitness. Built because grip socks kept failing when grip mattered most.
settings.pull_quote: We didn't improve the grip sock. We made it obsolete.

settings.title: Fashion trained the eye. The studio set the standard.
settings.body:
A former career as a fashion model took me around the world — design, textiles, architecture, craftsmanship, the details that elevate an experience.

That foundation meets a practice I take seriously. At the time, grippy yoga socks were the only tool available. They slipped when grip mattered most, required constant adjusting, and never delivered the control they promised.

I found myself breaking focus to fix my socks instead of holding the position — sliding out of side planks, resetting my feet. Fabric holds moisture. I wanted a clean, connected practice.

If I was dedicating an hour to my practice, I wanted that hour to count — secure, grounded, connected, and confident. And I knew I was not the only one.

settings.title: The idea became the product.
settings.body:
One day, stuck in side plank and sliding yet again, it became clear: this was not just inconvenient. It was holding us back.

That same evening, I tore the silicone sleeve off a water bottle, cut it up, and made the first prototype. Far from perfect. But it worked.

Two years of testing followed — pressure points, fit, flexibility, material, true all-over grip. Performance Skins were born: patented studio footwear, designed and manufactured in the USA. Built to feel secure and connected. Built to stay out of the way of the workout.

settings.title: Performance over promise
settings.description: Every claim we make is backed by the product itself. Injection-molded grip that never peels. Materials that never absorb. Results you can feel from day one.

settings.title: Category creation
settings.description: We're not competing in the grip sock market — we're replacing it. Performance Skins are a new category of studio footwear built from first principles.

settings.title: Durability as design
settings.description: Products should outlast the hype cycle. Many customers report 3–4 years of daily use. One purchase replaces years of disposable socks.

settings.title: Commitment match
settings.description: You show up 6 days a week. Your gear should match that commitment. Built for people who take their practice seriously.

settings.title: Studio-first
settings.description: Designed for the demands of real studio environments — reformer carriages, Megaformer platforms, barre floors. Every detail serves the practice.

settings.title: Joseph Pilates built the method around the feet.
settings.body:
Joseph Pilates developed his method, originally called Contrology, around breath, concentration, control, precision, alignment, flow, and full-body awareness. He also created the apparatus to serve that method: the Reformer, Cadillac, Wunda Chair, Ladder Barrel, Spine Corrector, Foot Corrector, Toe Corrector, and Ped-o-Pul.

The feet were always part of the system. In Pilates, the foot connects the body to the floor, the mat, the Reformer, the Cadillac, the Wunda Chair, the Megaformer — every surface beneath you. That connection is the work.

Pilates depends on feedback. The foot has to sense, press, articulate, stabilize, and respond. A grip sock that slips, shifts, or bunches moves your focus off form and onto your footing. It is like holding a plank on a sliding towel. You can still do the move. Your body is compensating instead of engaging.

Clean feet, clean floors, wiped-down equipment — that's what creates a clean environment. The tool under you should support the practice, not work against it.

If you prefer a sock layer, have cold feet, or train in a studio that requires socks, Performance Skins can be worn over a very thin pair — toe-free or fitted — so you still feel the grip.

settings.question: What is Barreletics?
settings.answer: Barreletics makes patented Performance Skins — studio footwear for barre, Pilates, reformer, Lagree, and Megaformer. Founded in Michigan by Stefanie Miller. Made in the USA. One pair replaces disposable grip socks with 360° injection-molded grip.

settings.question: Open Sole or Closed Sole?
settings.answer: Closed Sole is heel and foot fully covered. Open Sole is heel exposed, mid-foot breathing hole — more grounded, barefoot feel, natural toe splay. Both perform identically — same grip, same stability. Choice is preference and feel only.

settings.question: How does this relate to Joseph Pilates and Contrology?
settings.answer: Joseph Pilates designed Contrology around the body's connection to the apparatus. The feet are part of that system — Reformer, Cadillac, Wunda Chair, mat. Performance Skins exist so that connection isn't interrupted by a sock that slips or holds moisture.

settings.question: Where are Performance Skins made?
settings.answer: Made in the USA. Designed and manufactured in Michigan. Material, injection molding, and quality stay domestic.
